errors.text_span: 随后在3至6之间维持在77.6%至77.8%之间
errors.evidence: This statement claims the F1 metric is maintained between 77.6% and 77.8% for captured_distance values from 3 to 6. However, the data points at x=3 (approx. 77.4%) and x=5 (approx. 77.9%) fall outside this range. This also incorrectly describes the trend, which shows a peak at x=5, not a plateau.
The F1 value at captured_distance=7 is approximately 76.6%, not 76.4% as stated. The data point is visibly more than halfway between the 76 and 77 marks.
The peak value for the Acc metric, which occurs at captured_distance=5, is approximately 77.2%, not 77.0%. The data point is visibly above the implicit 77% line.
